findings.issue: Detected a potential path traversal. A malicious actor could control the location of this file, to include going backwards in the directory with '../'. You may also consider using a utility method such as org.apache.commons.io.FilenameUtils.getName(...) to only retrieve the file name from the path.

findings.triage_reason: Verdict: The finding is valid; the code directly requests the deprecated DES cipher. Evidence: src/main/java/org/owasp/benchmark/testcode/BenchmarkTest00005.java:63 calls javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding"), and line 66 also derives the key with KeyGenerator.getInstance("DES"), confirming DES is the algorithm in use with no mitigation or alternative cipher selection.
